_about: AI-written visual descriptions ("Scene" sections) removed from this deck on 2026-10-04 at PlayfulProcess's word. See README.md in this folder.
deck_name: Sola Busca Tarot — The First Fully-Engraved Deck (N. Italy, c. 1491)

major-00-mato.name: 0 — Mato
major-00-mato.Scene: A half-naked jester in a red robe plays a recorder flute while walking on rocky ground. A black crow perches on his right shoulder. He wears an elaborate purple feathered headdress and short blue boots. Behind him a bare-branched tree rises and a cord or snake-like ribbon hangs from the branches.

major-01-panfilio.name: 1 — Panfilio
major-01-panfilio.Scene: A soldier shown from behind strides to the left. He carries a large battered oval shield and holds a short sword at his hip. He wears a green tunic with ruffled trim and a red conical helmet with a trailing ribbon plume. A flat horizon stretches behind him.

major-02-postumio.name: 2 — Postumio
major-02-postumio.Scene: A soldier shown from behind faces right. His round shield bears the inscribed name POSTVMIO beneath a palm-tree device. He grasps a blue-handled weapon at his side. A human skull rests on a low stone block beside him, with a dagger thrust into the stone and a red cloth falling from it.

major-03-lenpio.name: 3 — Lenpio
major-03-lenpio.Scene: An armored figure in blue plate armor shields his eyes with one raised hand while gazing upward, as if against bright light. He holds a bundle of dried grass or grain in the other hand. A tall red pole leans behind him. At his feet sits a wide decorated bowl or vessel.

major-04-mario.name: 4 — Mario
major-04-mario.Scene: A warrior strides forward wearing a winged green helmet. He carries a large dark-painted shield with a worn emblem and a gold-handled sword at his hip. A red military standard on a tall pole rises behind him. The gnarled trunk of a dead tree appears at lower right.

major-05-catulo.name: 5 — Catulo
major-05-catulo.Scene: A young figure with long curling hair and a laurel-wreath crown sits or leans against a surface. He wears purple plate armor and a flowing robe. He tilts a large blue shield and grips a handrail or staff with his other hand. A tall red flag rises behind him on a pole.

major-06-sesto.name: 6 — Sesto
major-06-sesto.Scene: A broad-shouldered soldier stands facing forward in pale puffed fabric armor. His right hand grips a tall red staff topped with a torch flame. His left hand rests on a large round ribbed shield leaning against his leg. A curved scroll or small horn hangs at his waist.

major-07-deo-tauro.name: 7 — Deo Tauro
major-07-deo-tauro.Scene: A laurel-crowned figure in red garments sits on a crescent-shaped throne or wheeled chariot upholstered in purple scale-like texture. He holds a long scepter tipped with a small orb and a ribbon pennant. Below him a blue disc inscribed with the letters S and C marks the wheel hub.

major-08-nerone.name: 8 — Nerone
major-08-nerone.Scene: A towering armored figure in purple holds a small naked child upside-down by one leg over flames burning on the ground. In his other hand he wields a long staff topped with a decorative knob, from which three balls hang on a red cord. A round spoked shield rests beside him at right.

major-09-falco.name: 9 — Falco
major-09-falco.Scene: An elderly bearded warrior in purple and red armor crouches low, bending backward with his face turned up toward the sky. He clutches a tall wooden staff wound with a ribbon. Behind him additional spears or poles lean at angles. His posture suggests exhaustion or reverence.

major-10-venturio.name: 10 — Venturio
major-10-venturio.Scene: A stout soldier walks to the right, seen from behind. He wears a large soft red hat with cascading feathers or plumes. He carries a tall vertical staff or pike. A sword and round shield hang at his back. A small fish-like creature appears underfoot on the ground.

major-11-tulio.name: 11 — Tulio
major-11-tulio.Scene: A bearded warrior faces left wearing a distinctive helmet ornamented with a large spiral snail-shell and a wing. He holds a flaming torch-scepter raised in his right hand. A curved sword hangs at his hip, and a wide pleated shield trails from his other hand.

major-12-carbone.name: 12 — Carbone
major-12-carbone.Scene: An elderly bearded man in a teal soft cap and purple robe walks leaning on a tall staff. He holds up a tall bronze oil lamp or chalice with a lit candle. A crescent moon hangs in the upper sky. At his side a round shield bearing the letters S.P.Q.R. rests on the ground, and a serpentine vine trails from the earth.

major-13-catone.name: 13 — Catone
major-13-catone.Scene: A triumphant soldier in purple scale armor strides forward, one foot planted on a severed enemy head at his feet. He unrolls a scroll inscribed REATS while gripping a long pike. A starburst radiates from the upper sky above him.

major-14-bocho.name: 14 — Bocho
major-14-bocho.Scene: A large armored figure stands gripping a tall red flag staff in one hand and a round silver shield in the other. His hair or headgear appears spiky or disheveled. His breastplate displays a quartered heraldic device. A round helmet and scattered armor pieces lie on the ground at his feet.

major-15-olivo.name: 15 — Olivo
major-15-olivo.Scene: A bearded warrior in ornate purple armor with a ruffled collar sits before a tall stone column topped with a burning brazier. He holds a short baton and gestures upward with his free hand. A large decorated shield rests on the ground to his left. A small bird perches on top of the column behind him.

major-16-metelo.name: 16 — Metelo
major-16-metelo.Scene: A crowned figure in a red tunic stands facing away, holding a staff. A large radiant sun fills the upper sky. A decorated vessel or bag rests at the figure's feet beside a flowering plant. A crouching owl or small animal sits at lower right.

major-17-ipeo.name: 17 — Ipeo
major-17-ipeo.Scene: A winged elderly man with long white hair and beard kneels in prayer, hands clasped and face raised skyward. He wears a pointed mitre-like cap and a long brown robe belted with a strand of dark beads. At upper right, a winged cherub head is mounted on a staff or branch.

major-18-lentulo.name: 18 — Lentulo
major-18-lentulo.Scene: An elderly bearded figure in a gold-latticed purple robe leans on a rectangular altar or table. A tall candlestick with a burning flame stands beside him. A military helmet lies discarded on the floor at his feet. A large red wheel is partly visible at left.

major-19-sabino.name: 19 — Sabino
major-19-sabino.Scene: A crowned warrior-king shown to the waist in purple plate armor grips a long lance or scepter in both hands. He wears a spiked crown and his face is framed by long grey hair and beard. A large blue shield with a spiral boss curves below him.

major-20-nenbroto.name: 20 — Nenbroto
major-20-nenbroto.Scene: A figure in purple and red armor strains dramatically, arms braced upward against a massive architectural column or trunk crashing down from the upper right. A carved column capital falls alongside. A blue round shield rests propped to the left. The figure is caught mid-effort, body twisted under the impact.

major-21-nabuchodenasor.name: 21 — Nabuchodenasor
major-21-nabuchodenasor.Scene: A figure in purple armor kneels forward, head lowered, handling a red fish or serpentine creature laid across a mat of straw or rays. Behind him a large blue celestial sphere is divided by a cross grid and dotted with gold stars. A golden eagle with spread wings flies across the top of the sphere.

cups-ace.name: Ace of Cups
cups-ace.Scene: A great ornate golden urn bears a Latin inscription around its rim; three red-winged putti hover above it -- one playing a pipe, one blowing a horn, one at centre. The vessel rests on a heraldic diamond pediment decorated with scrollwork. The suit-object as ceremonial trophy.

cups-02.name: Two of Cups
cups-02.Scene: Two large ornate stacked vessels -- a broad lower cup and a smaller upper one -- in a landscape. A red-winged putto child emerges from the upper cup, holding a pointed implement. Decorated handles curl from both vessels.

cups-03.name: Three of Cups
cups-03.Scene: Three covered urns arranged triangularly -- two above, one below -- linked by green stems that split into dramatic purple-red acanthus-leaf flourishes. No figures; a purely vegetal still-life of vessels and living growth.

cups-04.name: Four of Cups
cups-04.Scene: Beneath a shelf displaying three lidded cups, two figures contest a vessel: a standing muscular young man wrestles with a small winged figure (putto). A physical scene of struggle over possession.

cups-05.name: Five of Cups
cups-05.Scene: A man in a purple tunic strides across open ground carrying three cups tied around his body and a bundle of rushes over his shoulder. A small white dog trots at his heels. A fifth cup lies at his feet. A bearer moving under load.

cups-06.name: Six of Cups
cups-06.Scene: A massive trophy-vessel with six globular cups embedded in its body stands on a blue marble pedestal. Two small nude figures cling to the sides of the vessel. Sumptuous scale and decorative excess.

cups-07.name: Seven of Cups
cups-07.Scene: A naked boy stands triumphantly atop a great laurel-garlanded cup on a red cushioned platform, holding two cups raised outward. Four more cups surround the platform base; pineapple-like finials flank the scene. Seven cups total.

cups-08.name: Eight of Cups
cups-08.Scene: Two plump putti stand atop a purple cube wrestling with two large rope-banded cups. Six more cups sit below and around the cube, connected by red ribbons. A playful, energetic accumulation.

cups-09.name: Nine of Cups
cups-09.Scene: A naked bearded man (a river-god or triton figure) crouches at the water's edge, surrounded and almost overwhelmed by nine cups of various sizes. A serpentine creature coils at left. Utterly immersed in abundance.

cups-10.name: Ten of Cups
cups-10.Scene: A bearded face with small horns is almost entirely buried by ten cups crowding the entire composition -- one cup worn as a hat. A garland of red berries at the bottom. A grotesque, total immersion in the suit.

cups-page.name: Page of Cups
cups-page.Scene: An elegantly dressed young figure in red and blue stands before a purple column, gazing down contemplatively at an ornate urn on the column top. Hands raised in a near-prayer gesture. A fish or eel hangs from the belt.

cups-knight.name: Knight of Cups
cups-knight.Scene: NATANABO: A bearded, large-winged older man rides a horse in red garments. The name is inscribed above. A decorative cup sits at ground level below the horse. He appears to hold a scroll or staff.

cups-queen.name: Queen of Cups
cups-queen.Scene: POLISENA: A crowned woman sits on a wheeled throne beside an elaborate cup with writhing botanical growth and a rearing dragon behind her on a bare tree. She wears a blue gown and a pearl crown.

cups-king.name: King of Cups
cups-king.Scene: LUCIO CECILIO R.: A crowned king sits enthroned above a great lotus-cup pedestal, holding a blue heraldic shield. Decorative spheres and a leafless tree flank the throne. His name is inscribed on a plaque.

coins-ace.name: Ace of Coins
coins-ace.Scene: Three putti strain to hold aloft a great circular medallion bearing a Latin motto. A bull's skull with laurel hangs above; a scroll with text appears lower left. One boy bows with effort, one stands upright, one is winged. The suit's inaugural object displayed as civic trophy.

coins-02.name: Two of Coins
coins-02.Scene: Two profile portrait medallions stacked vertically, linked by a rope-twisted chain pendant: an upper laurel-wreathed classical head (ancient) and a lower figure in a red-cloaked Renaissance hat (modern). Two ages facing the same direction.

coins-03.name: Three of Coins
coins-03.Scene: A plump putto strides and strains carrying atop his head a great platter bearing three large floral coin-discs plus smaller spheres. Red and blue ribbon streamers flutter. The child bears an oversized load.

coins-04.name: Four of Coins
coins-04.Scene: A near-naked woman with small horns -- partially draped in blue cloth -- stands bearing an enormous stack of four large coin-discs on her back. She holds a fifth coin at her hip. An earthy image of feminine burden.

coins-05.name: Five of Coins
coins-05.Scene: A hunched figure in a dark cloak bends forward under the weight of five suspended coins on rods. Shadowy figures appear in the background corners. A dark, burdened scene of accumulation as affliction.

coins-06.name: Six of Coins
coins-06.Scene: A craftsman in a purple robe kneels at a workbench, hammer in hand, engraving or striking. Above him an architectural canopy holds many coins. A doorway opens to landscape behind. Focused labour in the world of matter.

coins-07.name: Seven of Coins
coins-07.Scene: A nude youth sits beside a large blue vessel overflowing with seven coins, tending its base. A bird of prey (eagle or hawk) stands to the left. Large dark wings flank the vessel above. Tending accumulated wealth under a watching guardian.

coins-08.name: Eight of Coins
coins-08.Scene: A large woven basket packed with eight coins stands beside a bare, twisted tree. Below: a human skull and crossed bones. One coin lies fallen on the ground. A stark memento-mori -- wealth beside death.

coins-09.name: Nine of Coins
coins-09.Scene: A great armored, fish-scaled vessel holds nine coins amid flames burning on all sides. A small figure cowers beneath the vessel's legs. A single coin lies separate at lower left. Trial by fire.

coins-10.name: Ten of Coins
coins-10.Scene: A wooden treasure chest overflows with ten coins; a small putto sits on the lid holding one aloft. A chained pig stands below. A lit candelabra stands to the left. Abundance in the physical world, with animal appetite tethered below.

coins-page.name: Page of Coins
coins-page.Scene: An elegantly dressed young man stands outdoors, a long staff beside him topped by a perched hawk. A second bird is in flight in the background. One coin lies at his feet. Falconry and the coin held together.

coins-knight.name: Knight of Coins
coins-knight.Scene: SARAFINO: A young rider on a white horse at full gallop, leaning dramatically backward, in red garments. One large coin disc lies in the foreground below the horse's hooves.

coins-queen.name: Queen of Coins
coins-queen.Scene: ELENA: A crowned woman in red dress sits on a purple throne, carefully examining or polishing a large coin she holds in both hands. A tall dark column behind; a small serpentine-necked vase in the upper right.

coins-king.name: King of Coins
coins-king.Scene: R. FILIPO: A crowned armored king stands in military posture, holding a banner inscribed PAX and a large coin-disc. He leans against a wheel-shaped coin. A white dove perches on a nearby box. Peace and power held together.

batons-ace.name: Ace of Batons
batons-ace.Scene: Two red-winged putti together hold aloft a single large twisted baton, flanked by huge dark feathered wings (possibly an eagle's). The letters M and S appear between the boys. Red ribbons flutter; a sword, shield and snail shell are below. A heraldic emblematic device.

batons-02.name: Two of Batons
batons-02.Scene: A heavy-set nearly nude man in red boots and cap grasps two large batons that cross in an X. He strides and turns his head upward. A purple cloth streams behind. Confrontational energy in motion.

batons-03.name: Three of Batons
batons-03.Scene: A disembodied winged face fills the card. Three batons project upward from the crown; three more hang downward from the chin, passing through a laurel garland with red fruit and ribbon. A strange heraldic mask.

batons-04.name: Four of Batons
batons-04.Scene: A close-up warrior profile -- elaborate red-plumed helmet -- with four batons thrust through or projecting from the headgear. A partial shield at lower left. Martial concentration reduced to helmet and staves.

batons-05.name: Five of Batons
batons-05.Scene: A man in a red tunic strides forward, carrying five batons bundled over his shoulder. He holds a gourd in his free hand. A resolute working figure moving with purpose.

batons-06.name: Six of Batons
batons-06.Scene: A man in blue tunic and red stockings walks, six batons bundled and tied with a purple bow across his back. In his free hand: a lit lantern. Walking with both his burden and his own light.

batons-07.name: Seven of Batons
batons-07.Scene: A figure in blue and red hunches almost to the ground, nearly crushed beneath a bundle of seven batons tied with a large purple sash. An image of weight, endurance, or oppression.

batons-08.name: Eight of Batons
batons-08.Scene: Eight batons fan outward from a central decorative vase with scroll handles, set atop a base of red petals or flames. The batons radiate upward like a crown. No figure -- pure symbolic heraldry.

batons-09.name: Nine of Batons
batons-09.Scene: A young nude figure wades through water, cradling nine batons pressed against the chest. Rocky shoreline; a distant tree. Perseverance in motion through difficulty.

batons-10.name: Ten of Batons
batons-10.Scene: Ten batons fan upward from a red cylindrical pedestal. Two more batons cross horizontally in front. A small medallion portrait (laurel-crowned head in a wreath) is set into the pedestal base. A trophy arrangement.

batons-page.name: Page of Batons
batons-page.Scene: A young figure in Renaissance costume -- cream tabard, red and blue hose -- stands in a landscape holding a single tall baton, a tassel at the belt. Calm and composed.

batons-knight.name: Knight of Batons
batons-knight.Scene: APOLINO: A rider on a white horse carrying a baton over one shoulder, in red robes and light helmet. He gestures forward with his free hand. Horse and rider move at a measured pace.

batons-queen.name: Queen of Batons
batons-queen.Scene: PALAS: A crowned woman sits on a throne marked D.P. She holds a baton upright and gestures with her other hand. A crumpled metallic object (shield or armour) lies at her feet.

batons-king.name: King of Batons
batons-king.Scene: LEVIO PLAUTO R.: A crowned king in blue armour sits enthroned between two lion heads, holding a baton and raising one finger in command. A purple arch frames him.

swords-ace.name: Ace of Swords
swords-ace.Scene: Two armored soldiers -- marked M and S -- stand close together; between them a massive red sword blade thrusts straight upward, towering the full height of the card. One in red armour, one in blue with a serpentine-crested helm. A shield leans against them. Two witnesses to one supreme blade.

swords-02.name: Two of Swords
swords-02.Scene: Two nude figures -- an adult and a younger one, both with small horns -- each grip a large red sword. A flock of birds flies across the background. A green cloth beneath. Two figures, two blades: confrontation or accord.

swords-03.name: Three of Swords
swords-03.Scene: Three red swords pierce a large red heart -- one from above, two crossing from the sides. The heart rests in a golden winged bowl-nest with a laurel garland. Below: scattered spheres. A composition that likely influenced the Waite-Smith Three of Swords five centuries later.

swords-04.name: Four of Swords
swords-04.Scene: Four red swords are bundled in an X-cross and bound at centre by a laurel wreath with decorative knots. Below the bundle hangs an animal skull (bovine). Scattered spheres surround. A funerary trophy.

swords-05.name: Five of Swords
swords-05.Scene: Five red swords thrust upward from a large ornate blue vessel with a fish-scale surface on a decorative stand. Red floral buds emerge from the base. A formal heraldic still-life.

swords-06.name: Six of Swords
swords-06.Scene: A large muscular figure bends forward and downward under the weight of six red swords -- some piercing through a large shield on his back. He grips one sword in hand. Extreme exertion or subjugation.

swords-07.name: Seven of Swords
swords-07.Scene: A nude youth with a laurel wreath sits casually against a large green barrel holding multiple swords. He holds one sword; a ribbon inscribed S.P.Q.R. lies at his feet beneath a shield. Guarded treasury, casual possession.

swords-08.name: Eight of Swords
swords-08.Scene: A nude youth embraces a large decorative vessel crowded with eight red swords projecting upward. Red ribbons coil around him. A garland with fruit and faces surrounds the vessel's mid-section. Entanglement with multiplied force.

swords-09.name: Nine of Swords
swords-09.Scene: A nude man bends at the waist, pulling a sword from the ground beside a tall red stand holding eight more swords above. A small winged putto sits atop the stand and observes. Effort witnessed from above.

swords-10.name: Ten of Swords
swords-10.Scene: A figure in purple and red hunches forward with ten swords fanning out across their back like a burden, facing away from the viewer. A white cloth billows before them. Departure under the weight of all ten blades.

swords-page.name: Page of Swords
swords-page.Scene: A young figure plays a lute outdoors, a large red sword leaning against a nearby twisted tree. The figure wears a flower garland and rich dress. Music and the blade coexist -- peace and war held in the same scene.

swords-knight.name: Knight of Swords
swords-knight.Scene: AMONE: A figure labeled AMONE wrestles and grapples with a large dark horse -- gripping the animal with both arms -- while a massive red sword is present in the scene. A bare tree behind. Not a mounted charge but a struggle for mastery over the animal.

swords-queen.name: Queen of Swords
swords-queen.Scene: OLIMPIA: A crowned woman sits beneath a great arching laurel tree, holding a long red sword upright. Red and blue robes. An oval ornament hangs from the tree above. Composed and regal authority.

swords-king.name: King of Swords
swords-king.Scene: ALLEXANDRO M.: A crowned armored king stands powerfully, flanked by two large dark-winged griffins or eagles. He holds a red sword at his side and an orb in the other hand. A wheel and chariot elements appear behind. The most imposing of all the court cards.

kw-pip.name: Pip
kw-pip.Scene: The pip cards of the Sola Busca are entirely figurative — no geometric arrangements of suit symbols appear. Every numbered card depicts one or more human figures in action scenes, giving the pips the same narrative density as the named-figure trumps. Armor, weapons, altars, animals, and classical props populate each card.

kw-engraving.name: Engraving
kw-engraving.Scene: The Sola Busca (1491) is the earliest known complete tarot deck to survive in engraved form. The lines are clean and precise, with fine cross-hatching for shadow and modeling. The engravings show the influence of Ferrarese and North Italian Renaissance workshop practice, with drapery and musculature rendered in careful detail.

kw-major.name: Major
kw-major.Scene: The twenty-two major cards each depict a named historical or mythological figure rather than a standard allegorical trump. The figures are identified by inscriptions and Roman numerals. Each stands, sits, or acts within a shallow landscape setting, often wearing elaborate Renaissance armor and carrying attributes specific to their legend.

kw-named-figure.name: Named figure
kw-named-figure.Scene: Each card in this category carries an inscribed name — Roman generals, biblical rulers, and semi-legendary figures from antiquity. The names appear as labels at the top or bottom of the card. The figures are individualized through posture, costume, and attribute rather than through facial portraiture.

kw-renaissance.name: Renaissance
kw-renaissance.Scene: The deck reflects late fifteenth-century North Italian Renaissance visual culture: classical Roman references, antique armor, triumphal imagery, and heraldic devices. The landscape backgrounds are plain horizons with sparse detail, consistent with Ferrarese engraving of the period.

kw-trionfi.name: Trionfi
kw-trionfi.Scene: The Sola Busca adapts the trionfi (triumph) tradition by replacing standard allegorical trumps with historical figures arranged in a numbered sequence. There is no Fool, Pope, or conventional Wheel of Fortune. Instead, the triumph sequence runs through Roman commanders and biblical kings, giving the deck a commemorative rather than cosmological tone.

kw-court.name: Court
kw-court.Scene: The court cards of the Sola Busca depict standing or mounted armored figures, consistent in style with the named-figure majors. Each court bears a figure in period-appropriate dress with suit-specific attributes — cups, batons, swords, or coins — held or displayed prominently.

kw-air.name: Air
kw-air.Scene: Cards associated with the air quality across the Sola Busca tend to show figures in dynamic lateral movement, with fluttering ribbons, banners, or loose garments suggesting wind and motion.

kw-batons.name: Batons
kw-batons.Scene: The Batons suit cards show figures holding torches, staves, or rod-like implements. Fire and flame imagery recurs across the suit pips, suggesting the link between batons and the fire element in Italian tradition.

kw-coins.name: Coins
kw-coins.Scene: The Coins suit features circular disc or medallion motifs. In several cards the coin or disc appears as a prop held, displayed, or incorporated into an architectural setting.

kw-cups.name: Cups
kw-cups.Scene: The Cups suit depicts chalices, bowls, and vessel forms. Several cards show the cup in ceremonial contexts — raised, offered, or set on altars — evoking libation and ritual within classical Roman imagery.

kw-earth.name: Earth
kw-earth.Scene: Cards with an earth quality show grounded, static postures, often with the figure leaning on a surface, seated, or connected to the ground through heavy armor or architectural elements.

kw-fire.name: Fire
kw-fire.Scene: Cards with a fire quality show torches, flames, and active, upward-thrusting gestures. The Batons suit cards carry this quality most directly through literal flame imagery on the suit implements.

kw-swords.name: Swords
kw-swords.Scene: The Swords suit cards depict bladed weapons — swords, daggers, and pikes. Several cards show combat, conquest, or military readiness, with weapons held aloft or at the ready.

kw-water.name: Water
kw-water.Scene: Cards with a water quality in the Sola Busca show cups, vessels, and occasionally aquatic or reflective surfaces. The postures tend toward containment and inward focus.

kw-ace.name: Ace
kw-ace.Scene: Each Ace in the Sola Busca places a single large suit emblem — torch, cup, coin, or sword — prominently within the composition, often held by or displayed before a single figure.

kw-eight.name: Eight
kw-eight.Scene: Eight-pip cards often depict rapid or decisive action, with figures in strong motion or urgent posture.

kw-five.name: Five
kw-five.Scene: Five-pip cards show asymmetry and tension, often depicting struggle, imbalance, or a figure standing apart from a group.

kw-four.name: Four
kw-four.Scene: Four-pip cards tend toward symmetry and stability in composition, with balanced groupings of figures or objects.

kw-king.name: King
kw-king.Scene: King cards show authoritative figures in commanding postures — standing over others, seated on thrones, or gesturing with their suit attribute as a symbol of dominion.

kw-knight.name: Knight
kw-knight.Scene: Knight cards show mounted figures or figures in active, mobile stances, emphasizing movement and pursuit.

kw-nine.name: Nine
kw-nine.Scene: Nine-pip cards carry a quality of near-completion — figures at the edge of a conclusion, holding positions of strength or strain.

kw-page.name: Page
kw-page.Scene: The Page cards in the Sola Busca depict youthful or smaller-scale figures. They carry their suit attributes with a lightness that distinguishes them from the weightier court figures above them.

kw-queen.name: Queen
kw-queen.Scene: Queen cards depict seated or enthroned female-coded figures, often shown with their suit attribute displayed in a ceremonial manner.

kw-seven.name: Seven
kw-seven.Scene: Seven-pip cards introduce complexity — multiple figures or objects with varying directions or intentions visible in a single scene.

kw-six.name: Six
kw-six.Scene: Six-pip cards suggest resolution or equilibrium following earlier tension, with compositions that feel more ordered than the fives.

kw-ten.name: Ten
kw-ten.Scene: The Ten cards bring the suit to its culmination, with compositions that feel densely populated or fully resolved.

kw-three.name: Three
kw-three.Scene: Three-pip cards introduce a third element or figure, often adding a dynamic that moves the scene beyond simple exchange.

kw-two.name: Two
kw-two.Scene: The Two cards show paired elements or two figures in relationship, whether cooperative or in opposition.

axis-keyword.name: By Keyword
axis-keyword.Scene: A navigational axis grouping all Sola Busca items by their shared keywords. Each keyword pill links to a set of cards that carry that tag — suit, element, number, card type, or iconographic category — allowing cross-cutting exploration of the deck.
